Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
feat(hooks): add mcp-cred-guard — block inline credentials in mcp.json files

PreToolUse:Write,Edit hook that denies writes to mcp.json/.mcp.json/.claude.json
when the content contains a credential-adjacent JSON key (token/key/secret/api/
password/auth/bearer) with a value that looks like a real secret rather than a
placeholder (${VAR}, <bracket>, your-*, changeme, ...).

Two-pass detection: jq parse (accurate for full JSON Write payloads) + grep regex
fallback (handles partial JSON fragments in Edit new_string). Whitelist covers
common placeholder forms and URLs. Bypass: export AAA_MCP_CRED_OK=1 before
starting Claude Code. Fail-safe: any jq/parse error exits 0 — never blocks
unrelated writes.

Root cause: ic-project session 2026-06-13 hardcoded an Apify API token in
.claude/mcp.json instead of referencing ${APIFY_API_TOKEN}.

20/20 tests passing.
